version: SAGI TACTICAL DIRECTOR TEST 02 · DETAIL SCRIPT · NO VOICE

execution_phases.name: BUILD
execution_phases.question: How does Pirlo receive and hold the first pressure long enough to prepare the next lane?

execution_phases.name: STRETCH
execution_phases.question: How does width create the vertical lane before Kaka moves?

execution_phases.name: BETWEEN_LINES
execution_phases.question: Who reacts first when Kaka accelerates between the lines?

execution_phases.name: OVERLAP
execution_phases.question: Why can the right back delay, then accelerate outside?

execution_phases.name: SHIFT_AND_SWITCH
execution_phases.question: In what order does the block shift before the switch?

execution_phases.name: COMPLETE
execution_phases.question: How does Seedorf exploit the weak-side pocket while Inzaghi pins the central defender?

visual_integrity.rule: Every tactical shot must preserve both the local relation and enough formation structure to understand where it belongs.
visual_integrity.minimum_context: carrier + next option + nearest defender + two structural anchors
visual_integrity.edge_safe_rule: No tactical subject should sit on or be clipped by the portrait-frame edge.
visual_integrity.background_rule: Wide tactical views may reveal more board, but must never reveal a hard visual void beyond the pitch.
visual_integrity.field_scope_rule: The amount of pitch visible must be chosen by tactical information need, not by a fixed camera aesthetic.

camera_continuity.principle: preserve spatial continuity, but allow deliberate tactical scale changes between structure and relation shots

action_continuity.principle: the next tactical action begins in body orientation before the current action fully ends

defensive_response.principle: space must be created by visible collective defensive movement, not by static empty zones

scale_script.principle: CENTRAL_MASTER provides the spatial map; STRUCTURE and RELATION shots then use only the pitch extent needed to explain the current tactical question
rules: use full or near-full pitch only when the viewer needs global structure
use half-pitch or zone framing when the tactical relation is local
never show the whole field just to look complete
never crop pitch landmarks that are needed to understand the action
return to wider pitch context after a local tactical explanation when the next phase depends on global spacing
global-to-local and local-to-global scale changes may be decisive when the tactical question changes

BUILD.purpose: show LCB-Pirlo-first pressure and enough midfield landmark context without shrinking players

STRETCH.purpose: show both side midfielders stretching the block while keeping the midfield relation readable on mobile

BETWEEN_LINES.purpose: show Pirlo-Kaka-defender relation without wasting screen on remote pitch

OVERLAP.purpose: show Kaka-RB-defender triangle and overlap timing

SHIFT_AND_SWITCH.purpose: return to the floating spatial map before the weak-side switch so the defensive block movement is visible

COMPLETE.purpose: show weak-side receive, central occupation, defenders and goal relation

OPENING_MASTER.purpose: establish the floating pitch as the spatial map before any local explanation

field_scale_script.principle: field visibility and camera scale are chosen by tactical information needs, not visual uniformity

stages.purpose: locate first build-up relation and attack direction
show midfield width and defensive block stretch
show receiver between lines without losing reference structure
show strong-side attraction and weak-side release
show weak-side reception, depth, defenders and goal

central_master.principle: use a stable floating pitch-centred master shot as the spatial map; the whole physical pitch board must remain visible with dark breathing room around it
rules: pitch board centre owns composition in CENTRAL_MASTER
show the full physical board silhouette, not only the white touchlines
preserve dark breathing room around the board so it reads as suspended in space
do not let player clusters drag the master shot off-centre
use the floating master briefly as spatial orientation, then return to tactical relation framing

camera_anticipation.principle: camera is driven by tactical triggers, not narration or ball location
rules: complete most reframing before the critical receive or run
keep the camera comparatively stable while the key relationship is being read
widen only when a global defensive movement is itself the tactical information
return local before the weak-side receiver controls the ball

tactical_script_detail.thesis: the weak-side receiver is free because central occupation and the overlap move the defensive block before the switch

phases.name: PIRLO_PREPARES
phases.trigger: LCB finds Pirlo after the first striker steps toward the ball
phases.attacker_detail: Pirlo receives side-on and delays the next pass while both side midfielders widen
phases.defender_reaction: O9 closes first; the midfield line stays compact before it is stretched
phases.spatial_change: central passing lane begins to open behind the first pressure
phases.camera_intent: start on floating master, then move into the Pirlo relationship before the structure changes

phases.name: KAKA_BETWEEN_LINES
phases.trigger: side midfielders have widened the midfield line enough for a vertical lane to appear
phases.attacker_detail: Kaka checks toward Pirlo, pauses, then accelerates diagonally into the right half-space
phases.defender_reaction: OM_C narrows first; OCB_R steps out later instead of moving at the same time
phases.spatial_change: the right outside lane becomes less protected as central defenders become occupied
phases.camera_intent: camera is already on Kaka and his nearest defenders before the pass arrives

phases.name: RIGHT_OVERLAP
phases.trigger: Kaka receives facing forward and central defenders have committed inward
phases.attacker_detail: RB waits until the central reaction is visible, opens his body upfield, then accelerates outside
phases.defender_reaction: OM_R tracks toward the touchline first while OCB_R remains concerned with Kaka and Inzaghi
phases.spatial_change: the strong side now contains ball, runner and multiple defenders
phases.camera_intent: move toward the right channel before RB starts the decisive run

phases.name: BLOCK_SHIFT
phases.trigger: RB receives on the outside with the defense already overloaded to the right
phases.attacker_detail: Inzaghi pins the central line; Seedorf stays away from the block, then advances into the weak-side lane
phases.defender_reaction: OM_R moves first, OM_C shifts second, OCB_R squeezes third, OCB_L follows last
phases.spatial_change: the defensive block travels right and leaves a larger receiving pocket on the left
phases.camera_intent: widen before the switch so the viewer sees the block move before seeing the pass

phases.name: WEAK_SIDE_EXECUTION
phases.trigger: the weak-side pocket is visible and Seedorf has a clean receiving angle
phases.attacker_detail: RB opens toward Seedorf; Seedorf checks to the ball, receives, then attacks diagonally toward goal while Inzaghi pins the far centre-back
phases.defender_reaction: OCB_L reacts first to Seedorf; OCB_R recovers later because he is still occupied centrally
phases.spatial_change: Seedorf attacks the gap created between a recovering centre-back and the goalkeeper
phases.camera_intent: arrive on Seedorf before the switch reaches him, then hold through the decisive action
